# Set up Applet

1. Call `list_apps`. If it fails with an authentication error, tell the user to connect Applet (they sign in on applet.one and approve access) and stop until they have.
2. If the user has apps, name them in one short line. If not, say Applet builds small stateful apps that are live at their own URL seconds after each change, and private until shared.
3. Ask what they would like to build, offering one concrete example (a lunch-order tracker, a sign-up sheet, a small dashboard). Do not create an app until they ask for one.
